description: Issue #824 cross-vendor review Finding 1: neutralizes DCExtension.IsFileAttachmentPrincipal -- the ONE shared comparison both IsFileAttachmentForeignKeyProperty and FileAttachmentSaveChangesGuard.BuildMap call (extracted in the PR #978 review follow-up specifically so the two consumers cannot drift again) -- with a compile-preserving revert to the pre-fix exact-type comparison (`principalClrType == typeof(FileAttachment)`, never a deletion), so a relationship whose principal is a class DERIVED from FileAttachment (TPH/TPT subclass) is no longer recognized as an attachment FK by EITHER consumer. This entry checks it against FileAttachmentForeignKeyPredicateDerivedPrincipalTests824's TPH predicate-level test; the sibling entry dcext824-derived-principal-neutralize-guard-kill checks the SAME patch against the guard's own end-to-end SaveChanges test, proving one shared implementation protects both code paths. green_tests is the sibling unrelated-property test in the same file, proving the mutation's blast radius is scoped to the derived-principal comparison and does not collaterally affect the ID-is-not-an-attachment-FK case.
